Both fixed before fresh comparisons. vLLM uses max_model_len1024, which covers every actual fixture prompt plus256 output tokens, and GPU memory utilization0.9 and an explicit320-block cache, admitted only when320 is within every reported automatic capacity. At1024 context, the fixture workload uses at most two512-token attention blocks plus three recurrent-state groups per request, allowing64 requests without allocating the oversized825-block idle pool. This gives vLLM a stronger workload-specific configuration than the earlier constrained control. Each keeps its qualifying prefill wait. A >=5% forward lead receives an immediate reverse-order check; failed forward profiles are not repeated unless their result may still qualify. Prefix and processor caches disabled; media UUID unique. No own compilation or sampling during timings; shared machine otherwise uncontrolled.
